title: The proper/open scalar word commutes with finite evaluation on arbitrary systems
statement: Fix a prime l, finite extensions E and L of Q_l, an embedding iota:E -> L and n >= 0. Let A=O_E/(pi_E^(n+1)), B=O_L/(pi_L^(n+1)) and phi the recorded quotient map. For any scheme morphism with compactification c [def-weil-compactifications-refinements], there are natural scalar evaluation isomorphisms s_W:ev_L,n S_W ~= (ev_E,n -) tensor_A^L B for every scheme W, and for every derived strict system N [def-trf-integral-comparison-sequence-systems] the following square commutes: evaluation of the actual systemCompactScalar [def-weil-system-operation-exchange-realization], followed by compact-support evaluation and compact support of s_X, equals s_Y followed by scalar extension of compact-support evaluation and the intrinsic finite scalar transpose [lem-sf-finite-compact-scalar-constructible]. The compact-support evaluation is exactly the composite of the specified proper evaluation mate and the inverse open evaluation mate. This is an equality of the specified arrows, for arbitrary unbounded systems, with no constructibility, Noetherian, complete or cartesian-system hypotheses.

proof.text: Use systemScalarFiniteEvaluation at every scheme W as the existential scalar comparison. It is constructed from normalized generic scalar evaluation by actual-to-generic and generic-to-fixed-finite adjoint-uniqueness isomorphisms, with no new proof hole.

Apply systemDirectScalar_finiteEvaluation to the proper part c.g at systemDerivedOpen(c.i)(N), and systemOpenScalar_finiteEvaluation to c.i at N. Both equations use exactly the scalar comparisons chosen in the preceding step.

Expand systemCompactScalar and the specified systemCompactEvaluation into their two factors. Naturality of the direct-image evaluation comparison moves the open scalar map through it. Functoriality of finite direct image transports the open equation, and the proper equation then applies. Naturality of finiteDirectScalar moves the open evaluation comparison through the finite proper scalar transpose. The scalar-transpose pasting identity identifies the two remaining finite factors with intrinsicCompactScalar. Reassociate the compositions. These are equations of the specified arrows and prove the original statement unchanged.
